competences.description: Swings a giant sword to deal damage and decrease the target's Defense for 2 turns. This attack will deal more damage according to your MAX HP.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy with a humiliating strike to provoke the target for 1 turn, and increases the Provoke effect by 1 turn, up to 3 turns, if you attack the provoked enemy. This attack will deal more damage according to your MAX HP.

Decreases the chances of receiving critical hits by 50%, and decreases the cooldown of your skill each time you're attacked. In addition, increases your Attack Bar by 30% if you get attacked by non critical hits. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
